messages:
mika: Hey all — Mika joining platform team today. Quick access question: I can see Console (viewer) in Okta but I need staging admin to validate a migration and eventually prod admin to flip a couple of feature flags. Who do I ask and what's the minimal info I should include?

tony: welcome Mika :wave: For staging we usually add you to the okta group `console-admin-staging` (self-service). Prod `console-admin` needs manager signoff + security. If the staging group isn't visible, open an ENG-IT ticket and ping me.

claire: hi Mika — i'm your manager. i'll approve prod once ENG-IT has the request. Two small asks: 1) include exact flag names, 2) put a requested expiry (we default 30 days for new hires).

mika: thanks — what's the exact ticket text you want?

tony: Paste this into ENG-IT (minimal):

Request: console-admin-staging (or console-admin-prod if approved), flags-admin (LaunchDarkly)
Manager: Claire Wong
Justification: Validate migration for scheduler service and toggle scheduler_v2 for staged canary testing
Flags: scheduler_v2, scheduler_kill_switch
Requested expiry: 2024-11-05
Rollout plan: canary 3% -> 20% -> 100%; metrics: error_rate, job_success_rate, p95 runtime; rollback: revert to previous flag state if error_rate increases >1.5%

ld-admin: Also add your LaunchDarkly username in the ticket. We'll scope `flags-admin` to the specific projects you listed and set the expiry. New hires get 30-day windows by default.

infra-bot: Pro tip: preview flags locally with `rdwctl flags preview scheduler_v2 --env=staging --whoami` and check flag history in Console before changes.

mika: I enabled 2FA but haven't added a YubiKey yet. Is that required for prod admin?

onboarding-bot: Reminder: YubiKey registration is required for prod admin grants. Setup: https://okta.redwood/setup-2fa.

security-bot: Security note: prod admin grants are audited. Include the ENG-IT ticket number and list exact flags. Least-privilege only. We'll run an access checklist after manager approval.

mika: Perfect — i'll open the ENG-IT ticket with that body and ping @tony and @claire. Thanks for the quick answers! :smile:
